radiation_texture_toggle.title: Radiation Texture Toggle
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s radiationTextureToggle matches 0 run tag @s add no_radiation_texture
execute if score @s radiationTextureToggle matches 1 run tag @s remove no_radiation_texture
execute if score @s radiationTextureToggle matches 2 run scoreboard players set @s radiationTextureToggle 0

tick.title: Passive
commands: execute as @e[tag=meteorite] at @s run particle flame ~ ~ ~ 0.15 0.15 0.15 0 10 force @a[distance=..50]
execute as @e[tag=meteorite] at @s run particle campfire_cosy_smoke ~ ~ ~ 0.15 0.15 0.15 0.02 5 force @a[distance=..50]
execute as @e[tag=meteorite] at @s run particle minecraft:dragon_breath ~ ~ ~ 0.2 0.2 0.2 0 8 force @a[distance=..50]
execute as @e[tag=meteorite] at @s run particle minecraft:enchanted_hit ~ ~ ~ 0.08 0.08 0.08 0 5 force @a[distance=..50]
execute as @e[tag=meteorite] at @s run particle minecraft:happy_villager ~ ~ ~ 0.1 0.1 0.1 0 6 force @a[distance=..50]
execute as @e[tag=meteorite] at @s run particle minecraft:lava ~ ~ ~ 0.08 0.08 0.08 0 5 force @a[distance=..50]
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 12 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 11
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches -1 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 0
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 1 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 0
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 2 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 1
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 3 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 2
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 4 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 3
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 5 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 4
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 6 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 5
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 7 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 6
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 8 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 7
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 9 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 8
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 10 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 9
execute if score @s DamageCycle matches 11 run scoreboard players set @s DamageCycle 10

true_damage_laser.title: True Damage Laser
true_damage_laser.description: Fires a focused Power Stone laser that deals true damage equal to 80% of the target’s maximum health.
